title: SAP Project Manager
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role:

We are looking for a Senior SAP Project Manager to join a global manufacturing company for a key implementation in Brazil and Latam.

The ideal candidate will have experience in SAP SD-LE and MM , logistics processes (3PL) , and EDI .


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead project milestones, manage risks, and ensure deliverables are met
  • Coordinate with business and IT stakeholders across regional and global teams
  • Track project progress, manage issues, and compile status reports
  • Support SIT/UAT testing, cut-over planning, hyper care, and change requests (CRs)

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in SAP Project Management
  • Strong technical background in SAP SD-LE and MM
  • Exposure to 3PL and EDI processes
  • Advanced English and intermediate Spanish
  • Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills


UST is waiting for you!!

title: AWS Administrator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno
description:
Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

O Desenvolvedor Pleno é um profissional multi-skill, com olhar para o design digital e com experiência nos elementos de experiência do usuário e acessibilidade. O foco principal do trabalho será em projetos de baixa complexidade, atuando com desenvolvimento de aplicações IVA, no Veeva, programação de banners animados HTML/CSS, com o GWD e e-mails marketing , mas também incluirá edição de conteúdo de websites, uso de webapps de terceiros e estruturas de programas para o iPad. Espera-se que você forneça suporte às equipes de desenvolvimento sênior na codificação, atualize o código existente com pedidos de mudança de conteúdo e auxilie na depuração de problemas logados pelo time de QA. Haverá o uso diário de ferramentas como Figma, Adobe XD e Photoshop (assim como de outros programas do Adobe Creative Suite). Você deverá estar familiarizado com estes programas e se sentir confortável em usá-los para visualizar layouts e exportar imagens.


Responsabilidades:

• Domínio da plataforma Veeva para o desenvolvimento e manutenção em IVAs.

• Programação de banners e emails (formatos iniciais e ajustes de materiais já existentes);

• Elaboração de screenshots (para os quais terá um treinamento por parte da empresa);

• Entendimento dos pedidos e instruções em inglês nos documentos marcados e implementar as mudanças solicitadas;

• Participar de scrums internos e/ou planejamento de projetos;

• Traduzir projetos criativos para um código limpo e livre de erros que se alinhe às melhores práticas do Studio Rx;

• Assegurar que os pedidos de trabalho sejam concluídos com qualidade e no tempo estabelecido;

• Obter e manter as certificações exigidas, conforme identificadas pela equipe de Operações.


Requerimentos & Skills:

• Bacharelado em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas;

• 4-6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento com proficiência em desenvolvimento web de front-end (padrões web HTML5);

• Certificação Veeva para desenvolvimento de IVAs;

• Experiência com animações CSS, transições e uso de key frame;

• Experiência com estruturas Javascript ou JS (Jquery, Angular, Node);

• Experiência com Git, Azure, SVN, ou sistemas de controle de versões similares;

• Uso do Adobe Creative Suite (Figma, XD e Photoshop);

• Familiaridade com HTML 5 e Web Standards, SEO, Acessibilidade, desenvolvimento de e-mails visando à compatibilidade cross-browser/cross-platform, javascript e algum framework (React, Angular, Vue, Next);

• Uso de ferramentas para emular dispositivos móveis e sistemas operacionais (BrowserStack, E-mail on Acid);

• Familiarizado com dispositivos tablet (Android, iPad) e smartphones;

• Inglês Avançado (foco em leitura, interpretação de texto e escrita).


Informações Adicionais:

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 ás 19h00

description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role:

We are looking for a Senior SAP Project Manager to join a global manufacturing company for a key implementation in Brazil and Latam.

The ideal candidate will have experience in SAP SD-LE and MM , logistics processes (3PL) , and EDI .


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead project milestones, manage risks, and ensure deliverables are met
  • Coordinate with business and IT stakeholders across regional and global teams

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in SAP Project Management
  • Strong technical background in SAP SD-LE and MM
  • Exposure to 3PL and EDI processes
  • Advanced English and intermediate Spanish
  • Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno
description:
Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

O Desenvolvedor Pleno é um profissional multi-skill, com olhar para o design digital e com experiência nos elementos de experiência do usuário e acessibilidade. O foco principal do trabalho será em projetos de baixa complexidade, atuando com desenvolvimento de aplicações IVA, no Veeva, programação de banners animados HTML/CSS, com o GWD e e-mails marketing , mas também incluirá edição de conteúdo de websites, uso de webapps de terceiros e estruturas de programas para o iPad. Espera-se que você forneça suporte às equipes de desenvolvimento sênior na codificação, atualize o código existente com pedidos de mudança de conteúdo e auxilie na depuração de problemas logados pelo time de QA. Haverá o uso diário de ferramentas como Figma, Adobe XD e Photoshop (assim como de outros programas do Adobe Creative Suite). Você deverá estar familiarizado com estes programas e se sentir confortável em usá-los para visualizar layouts e exportar imagens.


Responsabilidades:

• Domínio da plataforma Veeva para o desenvolvimento e manutenção em IVAs.

• Programação de banners e emails (formatos iniciais e ajustes de materiais já existentes);

• Elaboração de screenshots (para os quais terá um treinamento por parte da empresa);

• Entendimento dos pedidos e instruções em inglês nos documentos marcados e implementar as mudanças solicitadas;

• Participar de scrums internos e/ou planejamento de projetos;

• Traduzir projetos criativos para um código limpo e livre de erros que se alinhe às melhores práticas do Studio Rx;

• Assegurar que os pedidos de trabalho sejam concluídos com qualidade e no tempo estabelecido;

• Obter e manter as certificações exigidas, conforme identificadas pela equipe de Operações.


Requerimentos & Skills:

• Bacharelado em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas;

• 4-6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento com proficiência em desenvolvimento web de front-end (padrões web HTML5);

• Certificação Veeva para desenvolvimento de IVAs;

• Experiência com animações CSS, transições e uso de key frame;

• Experiência com estruturas Javascript ou JS (Jquery, Angular, Node);

• Experiência com Git, Azure, SVN, ou sistemas de controle de versões similares;

• Uso do Adobe Creative Suite (Figma, XD e Photoshop);

• Familiaridade com HTML 5 e Web Standards, SEO, Acessibilidade, desenvolvimento de e-mails visando à compatibilidade cross-browser/cross-platform, javascript e algum framework (React, Angular, Vue, Next);

• Uso de ferramentas para emular dispositivos móveis e sistemas operacionais (BrowserStack, E-mail on Acid);

• Familiarizado com dispositivos tablet (Android, iPad) e smartphones;

• Inglês Avançado (foco em leitura, interpretação de texto e escrita).


Informações Adicionais:

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 ás 19h00

description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role:

We are looking for a Senior SAP Project Manager to join a global manufacturing company for a key implementation in Brazil and Latam.

The ideal candidate will have experience in SAP SD-LE and MM , logistics processes (3PL) , and EDI .


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead project milestones, manage risks, and ensure deliverables are met
  • Coordinate with business and IT stakeholders across regional and global teams
  • Track project progress, manage issues, and compile status reports
  • Support SIT/UAT testing, cut-over planning, hyper care, and change requests (CRs)

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in SAP Project Management
  • Strong technical background in SAP SD-LE and MM
  • Exposure to 3PL and EDI processes
  • Advanced English and intermediate Spanish
  • Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills


UST is waiting for you!!

title: AWS Administrator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

  • Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills

title: AWS Administrator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Pessoa Especialista de Dados e DevOps
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, SREs e engenheiros de plataforma para garantir confiabilidade e eficiência no ciclo de vida das aplicações.
  • Integrar validações de segurança e qualidade (DevSecOps) nos pipelines de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de GitOps, automação de deploys e rollback seguro.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de observabilidade, garantindo que logs, métricas e alertas estejam integrados ao fluxo de entrega.
  • Automatizar operações relacionadas a bancos de dados, como migrations, versionamento e sincronização entre ambientes.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de DBA para garantir que as mudanças em dados sejam seguras, rastreáveis e padronizadas.
  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.
  • Promover cultura DevOps entre os times, disseminando boas práticas de colaboração e automação.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi.
  • Contêineres e Orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS).
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog.
  • Versionamento e Gestão de Código: Git, GitOps.
  • Automação de Banco de Dados: ferramentas como Liquibase, Flyway, Alembic.
  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).
  • Segurança em pipelines: integração de SAST, DAST, IaC scanning.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Customer Service Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10,5 - $17,5 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary :


The Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for providing exceptional customer support, resolving inquiries and complaints, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience across all communication channels.


Job Tasks :


  • Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media in a timely and professional manner.
  • Problem Resolution: Identify customer issues, troubleshoot problems, and provide effective solutions or escalate when necessary.
  • Account Management: Update and maintain accurate customer records and account information in the system.
  • Product Knowledge: Maintain comprehensive knowledge of products and services to provide accurate information and guidance.
  • Communication: Build positive relationships with customers through empathetic and clear communication.
  • Reporting and Feedback: Document customer interactions, track recurring issues, and provide feedback to improve service quality.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

title: AI Gateway Engineer
description:
AI Gateway Engineer

We are seeking a skilled AI Gateway Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with AI or API gateways, a strong background in backend development, and expertise in deploying and optimizing AI/ML models in a production environment. You will be instrumental in building and scaling our AI infrastructure within an enterprise-grade setting.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and manage AI/API gateways like Kong, Mosaic, or Portkey.
  • Develop and maintain backend services, primarily using Go , with Python as a valuable secondary skill.
  • Optimize and productize AI/ML models for production use, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Leverage AWS to build and manage our cloud infrastructure.
  • Implement and manage observability tools, including OpenTelemetry (OTel), Grafana, and Prometheus , to monitor system health and performance.
  • Apply prompt engineering techniques to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of AI models.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and deployment of AI solutions.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • Proven experience with API or AI gateways (e.g., Kong, Mosaic, Portkey).
  • Strong backend development skills, particularly in Go ; proficiency in Python is a plus.
  • Experience with AI/ML optimization and productization .

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno
description:
Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

O Desenvolvedor Pleno é um profissional multi-skill, com olhar para o design digital e com experiência nos elementos de experiência do usuário e acessibilidade. O foco principal do trabalho será em projetos de baixa complexidade, atuando com desenvolvimento de aplicações IVA, no Veeva, programação de banners animados HTML/CSS, com o GWD e e-mails marketing , mas também incluirá edição de conteúdo de websites, uso de webapps de terceiros e estruturas de programas para o iPad. Espera-se que você forneça suporte às equipes de desenvolvimento sênior na codificação, atualize o código existente com pedidos de mudança de conteúdo e auxilie na depuração de problemas logados pelo time de QA. Haverá o uso diário de ferramentas como Figma, Adobe XD e Photoshop (assim como de outros programas do Adobe Creative Suite). Você deverá estar familiarizado com estes programas e se sentir confortável em usá-los para visualizar layouts e exportar imagens.


Responsabilidades:

• Domínio da plataforma Veeva para o desenvolvimento e manutenção em IVAs.

• Programação de banners e emails (formatos iniciais e ajustes de materiais já existentes);

• Elaboração de screenshots (para os quais terá um treinamento por parte da empresa);

• Entendimento dos pedidos e instruções em inglês nos documentos marcados e implementar as mudanças solicitadas;

• Participar de scrums internos e/ou planejamento de projetos;

• Traduzir projetos criativos para um código limpo e livre de erros que se alinhe às melhores práticas do Studio Rx;

• Assegurar que os pedidos de trabalho sejam concluídos com qualidade e no tempo estabelecido;

• Obter e manter as certificações exigidas, conforme identificadas pela equipe de Operações.


Requerimentos & Skills:

• Bacharelado em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas;

• 4-6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento com proficiência em desenvolvimento web de front-end (padrões web HTML5);

• Certificação Veeva para desenvolvimento de IVAs;

• Experiência com animações CSS, transições e uso de key frame;

• Experiência com estruturas Javascript ou JS (Jquery, Angular, Node);

• Experiência com Git, Azure, SVN, ou sistemas de controle de versões similares;

• Uso do Adobe Creative Suite (Figma, XD e Photoshop);

• Familiaridade com HTML 5 e Web Standards, SEO, Acessibilidade, desenvolvimento de e-mails visando à compatibilidade cross-browser/cross-platform, javascript e algum framework (React, Angular, Vue, Next);

• Uso de ferramentas para emular dispositivos móveis e sistemas operacionais (BrowserStack, E-mail on Acid);

• Familiarizado com dispositivos tablet (Android, iPad) e smartphones;

• Inglês Avançado (foco em leitura, interpretação de texto e escrita).


Informações Adicionais:

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 ás 19h00

title: AWS Administrator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Workload Management:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

title: Analista Sr - Qualidade Pesquisa Clínica - IDOR SP
description:
Fundado em 2010 no Rio de Janeiro, o Instituto D’Or de Pesquisa e Ensino (IDOR) é uma organização sem fins lucrativos cujo objetivo é contribuir para a evolução da ciência, de forma a melhorar a condição de vida humana. Para isso, combina pesquisa de ponta, capacitação profissional, desenvolvimento tecnológico e inovação na área da saúde. Sua principal mantenedora é a Rede D’Or São Luiz (RDSL), maior rede hospitalar privada da América Latina.

Desde sua criação, o IDOR valoriza a ciência e se mantém atento às necessidades do país na área da saúde, mobilizando seus recursos e estimulando seus pesquisadores na busca de soluções para problemas atuais e futuros. A partir de 2022, passou também a investir em Ensino através da Faculdade IDOR de Ciências Médicas, que conta atualmente com cursos de graduação em Radiologia, Enfermagem, Psicologia e Técnico de Enfermagem.


Requisitos


A área de Qualidade em Pesquisa Clínica é responsável por assegurar que todos os processos relacionados a ensaios clínicos sejam conduzidos conforme normas nacionais e internacionais, garantindo a integridade científica dos dados, a segurança dos participantes e a aderência regulatória. Atuamos na padronização de processos, execução de auditorias, monitoramento de indicadores e implementação de melhorias contínuas.


- Formação superior em Enfermagem, Farmácia, Biomedicina, Medicina ou áreas correlatas da saúde;

- Pós-graduação ou especialização em Pesquisa Clínica, Gestão da Qualidade ou Auditoria em Saúde;

- Espanhol técnico para interface com centros da América Latina;

- Desejável experiência consolidada em auditorias de pesquisa clínica.

- Desejável conhecimento avançado em ICH-GCP, legislação nacional (RDC 9/2015, Res. CNS 466/2012,

510/2016) e boas práticas de auditoria.

- Desejável experiência prévia com auditorias de sistemas e fornecedores. Capacidade de análise crítica e visão estratégica. Inglês avançado (oral e escrito), para conduzir auditorias e relatórios em âmbito internacional


Atividades


- Planejar, coordenar e executar auditorias de alta complexidade em todas as fases dos estudos clínicos.

- Elaborar relatórios executivos de auditoria, com recomendações estratégicas e planos de mitigação de risco.

- Liderar follow-up de CAPAs (ações corretivas e preventivas), avaliando impacto e eficácia das medidas implementadas.

- Atuar como mentor técnico para analistas plenos e juniores da equipe de auditoria.

- Contribuir para o desenvolvimento e revisão de políticas corporativas e POPs relacionados à auditoria e à qualidade.

- Participar de fóruns internos e externos de qualidade, representando a área em discussões regulatórias e estratégicas.

- Monitorar indicadores-chave de qualidade e propor iniciativas de melhoria contínua na gestão de auditorias.

title: Pessoa Especialista de Dados e DevOps
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, SREs e engenheiros de plataforma para garantir confiabilidade e eficiência no ciclo de vida das aplicações.
  • Integrar validações de segurança e qualidade (DevSecOps) nos pipelines de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de GitOps, automação de deploys e rollback seguro.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de observabilidade, garantindo que logs, métricas e alertas estejam integrados ao fluxo de entrega.
  • Automatizar operações relacionadas a bancos de dados, como migrations, versionamento e sincronização entre ambientes.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de DBA para garantir que as mudanças em dados sejam seguras, rastreáveis e padronizadas.
  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.
  • Promover cultura DevOps entre os times, disseminando boas práticas de colaboração e automação.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi.
  • Contêineres e Orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS).
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog.
  • Versionamento e Gestão de Código: Git, GitOps.
  • Automação de Banco de Dados: ferramentas como Liquibase, Flyway, Alembic.
  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).
  • Segurança em pipelines: integração de SAST, DAST, IaC scanning.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Customer Service Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10,5 - $17,5 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary :


The Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for providing exceptional customer support, resolving inquiries and complaints, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience across all communication channels.


Job Tasks :


  • Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media in a timely and professional manner.
  • Problem Resolution: Identify customer issues, troubleshoot problems, and provide effective solutions or escalate when necessary.
  • Account Management: Update and maintain accurate customer records and account information in the system.
  • Product Knowledge: Maintain comprehensive knowledge of products and services to provide accurate information and guidance.
  • Communication: Build positive relationships with customers through empathetic and clear communication.
  • Reporting and Feedback: Document customer interactions, track recurring issues, and provide feedback to improve service quality.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory

  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

title: AWS Administrator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: AI Gateway Engineer
description:
AI Gateway Engineer

We are seeking a skilled AI Gateway Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with AI or API gateways, a strong background in backend development, and expertise in deploying and optimizing AI/ML models in a production environment. You will be instrumental in building and scaling our AI infrastructure within an enterprise-grade setting.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and manage AI/API gateways like Kong, Mosaic, or Portkey.
  • Develop and maintain backend services, primarily using Go , with Python as a valuable secondary skill.
  • Optimize and productize AI/ML models for production use, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Leverage AWS to build and manage our cloud infrastructure.
  • Implement and manage observability tools, including OpenTelemetry (OTel), Grafana, and Prometheus , to monitor system health and performance.
  • Apply prompt engineering techniques to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of AI models.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and deployment of AI solutions.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • Proven experience with API or AI gateways (e.g., Kong, Mosaic, Portkey).

title: Consultor SAP Basis SR
description:
Procuramos Analista SAP BASIS SR queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Modalidade de Trabalho: Remoto, de 08h às 17h, (seg à sex).

Vaga para atuar em projeto de cliente.


Nesta função você irá:

  • Administração dos sistemas SAPs, instalação, configuração e atualização (ABAP e Java).
  • Monitoramento e ajuste do desempenho do sistema, aplicação e de patches e suporte packages.
  • Resolução de problemas nível 2 e suporte a usuários e nível 1.
  • Configuração e manutenção de landscapes de sistema e transportes de requests.
  • Criação de documentação técnica e procedimentos operacionais.
  • Acompanhamento relatório EWA para aplicação de melhorias no ambiente.
  • Aplicação de notas de segurança SAP.
  • Administração de banco de dados Oracle, Sybase, MaxDB e Hana.

Necessário para oportunidade:

  • Superior completo na área de tecnologia.
  • Experiência sólida em instalação, upgrade, migração e tuning de ambientes SAP (ECC, S/4 Hana, BW, PI/PO).
  • Domínio em banco de dados (HANA, Oracle, SYBASE, MaxDB).
  • Conhecimento de alta disponibilidade e backup/restore.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas operacionais Windows server, linux (red hat e suse).
  • Conhecimento em instalação, configuração e manutenção de sistemas SAP (ABAP e Java).

O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

O que oferecemos?

  • SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.
  • SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social.
  • E muito mais!

+ Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração

Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabermos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.


Faça parte da nossa equipe!

title: Pessoa Especialista de Dados e DevOps
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, SREs e engenheiros de plataforma para garantir confiabilidade e eficiência no ciclo de vida das aplicações.
  • Integrar validações de segurança e qualidade (DevSecOps) nos pipelines de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de GitOps, automação de deploys e rollback seguro.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de observabilidade, garantindo que logs, métricas e alertas estejam integrados ao fluxo de entrega.
  • Automatizar operações relacionadas a bancos de dados, como migrations, versionamento e sincronização entre ambientes.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de DBA para garantir que as mudanças em dados sejam seguras, rastreáveis e padronizadas.
  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.
  • Promover cultura DevOps entre os times, disseminando boas práticas de colaboração e automação.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi.
  • Contêineres e Orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS).
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog.
  • Versionamento e Gestão de Código: Git, GitOps.
  • Automação de Banco de Dados: ferramentas como Liquibase, Flyway, Alembic.
  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).
  • Segurança em pipelines: integração de SAST, DAST, IaC scanning.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Customer Service Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10,5 - $17,5 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary :


The Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for providing exceptional customer support, resolving inquiries and complaints, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience across all communication channels.


Job Tasks :


  • Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media in a timely and professional manner.
  • Problem Resolution: Identify customer issues, troubleshoot problems, and provide effective solutions or escalate when necessary.

title: AWS Administrator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

Health insurance

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

title: AI Gateway Engineer
description:
AI Gateway Engineer

We are seeking a skilled AI Gateway Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with AI or API gateways, a strong background in backend development, and expertise in deploying and optimizing AI/ML models in a production environment. You will be instrumental in building and scaling our AI infrastructure within an enterprise-grade setting.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and manage AI/API gateways like Kong, Mosaic, or Portkey.
  • Develop and maintain backend services, primarily using Go , with Python as a valuable secondary skill.
  • Optimize and productize AI/ML models for production use, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Leverage AWS to build and manage our cloud infrastructure.
  • Implement and manage observability tools, including OpenTelemetry (OTel), Grafana, and Prometheus , to monitor system health and performance.
  • Apply prompt engineering techniques to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of AI models.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and deployment of AI solutions.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • Proven experience with API or AI gateways (e.g., Kong, Mosaic, Portkey).
  • Strong backend development skills, particularly in Go ; proficiency in Python is a plus.
  • Experience with AI/ML optimization and productization .
  • Expertise in AWS , including its various services for building scalable applications.
  • Familiarity with observability tools like OTel, Grafana, and Prometheus.
  • Practical experience with prompt engineering .
  • A history of working in enterprise-grade environments .


Other Details:
  • Location: Remote (preferred in LATAM region)
  • Length: 1+ Year
  • Client: Gaming Giant

title: Pessoa Especialista de Dados e DevOps
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, SREs e engenheiros de plataforma para garantir confiabilidade e eficiência no ciclo de vida das aplicações.
  • Integrar validações de segurança e qualidade (DevSecOps) nos pipelines de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de GitOps, automação de deploys e rollback seguro.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de observabilidade, garantindo que logs, métricas e alertas estejam integrados ao fluxo de entrega.
  • Automatizar operações relacionadas a bancos de dados, como migrations, versionamento e sincronização entre ambientes.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de DBA para garantir que as mudanças em dados sejam seguras, rastreáveis e padronizadas.
  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.
  • Promover cultura DevOps entre os times, disseminando boas práticas de colaboração e automação.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi.
  • Contêineres e Orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS).
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog.
  • Versionamento e Gestão de Código: Git, GitOps.
  • Automação de Banco de Dados: ferramentas como Liquibase, Flyway, Alembic.
  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).
  • Segurança em pipelines: integração de SAST, DAST, IaC scanning.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Customer Service Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10,5 - $17,5 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary :


The Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for providing exceptional customer support, resolving inquiries and complaints, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience across all communication channels.


Job Tasks :


  • Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media in a timely and professional manner.
  • Problem Resolution: Identify customer issues, troubleshoot problems, and provide effective solutions or escalate when necessary.
  • Account Management: Update and maintain accurate customer records and account information in the system.
  • Product Knowledge: Maintain comprehensive knowledge of products and services to provide accurate information and guidance.
  • Communication: Build positive relationships with customers through empathetic and clear communication.
  • Reporting and Feedback: Document customer interactions, track recurring issues, and provide feedback to improve service quality.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

title: AWS Administrator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

Health insurance

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Reimbursement of Certifications

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

Modalidade de Trabalho: Remoto, de 08h às 17h, (seg à sex).

Nesta função você irá:

  • Administração dos sistemas SAPs, instalação, configuração e atualização (ABAP e Java).
  • Monitoramento e ajuste do desempenho do sistema, aplicação e de patches e suporte packages.
  • Resolução de problemas nível 2 e suporte a usuários e nível 1.
  • Configuração e manutenção de landscapes de sistema e transportes de requests.
  • Criação de documentação técnica e procedimentos operacionais.
  • Acompanhamento relatório EWA para aplicação de melhorias no ambiente.
  • Aplicação de notas de segurança SAP.
  • Administração de banco de dados Oracle, Sybase, MaxDB e Hana.

Necessário para oportunidade:

  • Superior completo na área de tecnologia.
  • Experiência sólida em instalação, upgrade, migração e tuning de ambientes SAP (ECC, S/4 Hana, BW, PI/PO).
  • Domínio em banco de dados (HANA, Oracle, SYBASE, MaxDB).
  • Conhecimento de alta disponibilidade e backup/restore.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas operacionais Windows server, linux (red hat e suse).
  • Conhecimento em instalação, configuração e manutenção de sistemas SAP (ABAP e Java).

O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

O que oferecemos?

  • SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.
  • SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social.
  • E muito mais!

title: Consultor SAP Basis SR
description:
Procuramos Analista SAP BASIS SR queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Modalidade de Trabalho: Remoto, de 08h às 17h, (seg à sex).

Vaga para atuar em projeto de cliente.


Nesta função você irá:

  • Administração dos sistemas SAPs, instalação, configuração e atualização (ABAP e Java).
  • Monitoramento e ajuste do desempenho do sistema, aplicação e de patches e suporte packages.
  • Resolução de problemas nível 2 e suporte a usuários e nível 1.
  • Configuração e manutenção de landscapes de sistema e transportes de requests.
  • Criação de documentação técnica e procedimentos operacionais.
  • Acompanhamento relatório EWA para aplicação de melhorias no ambiente.
  • Aplicação de notas de segurança SAP.
  • Administração de banco de dados Oracle, Sybase, MaxDB e Hana.

Necessário para oportunidade:

  • Superior completo na área de tecnologia.
  • Experiência sólida em instalação, upgrade, migração e tuning de ambientes SAP (ECC, S/4 Hana, BW, PI/PO).
  • Domínio em banco de dados (HANA, Oracle, SYBASE, MaxDB).
  • Conhecimento de alta disponibilidade e backup/restore.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas operacionais Windows server, linux (red hat e suse).
  • Conhecimento em instalação, configuração e manutenção de sistemas SAP (ABAP e Java).
