title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Customer Service Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10,5 - $17,5 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary :


The Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for providing exceptional customer support, resolving inquiries and complaints, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience across all communication channels.


Job Tasks :


  • Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media in a timely and professional manner.
  • Problem Resolution: Identify customer issues, troubleshoot problems, and provide effective solutions or escalate when necessary.
  • Account Management: Update and maintain accurate customer records and account information in the system.
  • Product Knowledge: Maintain comprehensive knowledge of products and services to provide accurate information and guidance.
  • Communication: Build positive relationships with customers through empathetic and clear communication.
  • Reporting and Feedback: Document customer interactions, track recurring issues, and provide feedback to improve service quality.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

title: AI Gateway Engineer
description:
AI Gateway Engineer

We are seeking a skilled AI Gateway Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with AI or API gateways, a strong background in backend development, and expertise in deploying and optimizing AI/ML models in a production environment. You will be instrumental in building and scaling our AI infrastructure within an enterprise-grade setting.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and manage AI/API gateways like Kong, Mosaic, or Portkey.
  • Develop and maintain backend services, primarily using Go , with Python as a valuable secondary skill.
  • Optimize and productize AI/ML models for production use, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Leverage AWS to build and manage our cloud infrastructure.
  • Implement and manage observability tools, including OpenTelemetry (OTel), Grafana, and Prometheus , to monitor system health and performance.
  • Apply prompt engineering techniques to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of AI models.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and deployment of AI solutions.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • Proven experience with API or AI gateways (e.g., Kong, Mosaic, Portkey).
  • Strong backend development skills, particularly in Go ; proficiency in Python is a plus.
  • Experience with AI/ML optimization and productization .
  • Expertise in AWS , including its various services for building scalable applications.
  • Familiarity with observability tools like OTel, Grafana, and Prometheus.
  • Practical experience with prompt engineering .
  • A history of working in enterprise-grade environments .


Other Details:
  • Location: Remote (preferred in LATAM region)
  • Length: 1+ Year
  • Client: Gaming Giant

title: Diretor de vendas
description:
Summary


At Hyatt Place São José do Rio Preto, we believe that hospitality is more than a service — it’s a way of connecting people and creating meaningful experiences. Guided by the Hyatt purpose “to care for people so they can be their best,” we are committed to fostering a culture where passion, integrity, and empathy drive everything we do.

We are looking for a Director of Sales with a strategic mindset, exceptional leadership, and strong business acumen to elevate our commercial performance, strengthen our market presence, and lead the brand’s commercial transformation in the region.

This is a unique opportunity for a visionary professional who thrives on challenges, inspires high-performing teams, and builds long-lasting relationships with stakeholders, corporate clients, and investors.

At Hyatt, we value our people as our greatest strength — offering a supportive environment that encourages growth, innovation, and balance . Here, your career goes beyond a job: it becomes a journey of learning, purpose, and global impact.


Qualifications


  • Education : Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Marketing, or related field required. A postgraduate degree (MBA or equivalent) will be considered a strong asset.
  • Language : Fluency in English and Portuguese is essential (both written and spoken). Additional languages will be considered a plus.
  • Experience : Experience in Sales leadership roles within the hospitality industry, preferably in international hotel brands.
  • Proven track record of driving commercial results, managing P&L structures, and leading high-performing sales teams.
  • Strong background in strategic account management, business development, and multichannel sales strategy.
  • Advanced knowledge of hotel revenue management, market segmentation, and commercial analytics.
  • Excellent executive communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to inspire teams, foster collaboration, and lead organizational change with resilience and empathy.
  • Proficiency in MS Office, CRM systems, and business intelligence tools (Hyatt systems experience is an advantage).

title: Senior Software Architect
description:
About Specialty Capital

Specialty Capital was founded just four years ago with a bold idea - to give “debanked” small businesses access to capital that’s Simple, Smart, and Reliable. Today, the company is among the top revenue-based finance companies in the U.S., serving thousands of merchants through a combination of speed, technology, and a deeply human approach. We’re now entering our next chapter and scaling into new financial verticals (credit cards, payments, and neo-bank integrations) and expanding internationally, starting with Canada. The company is profitable, founder-led, and growing rapidly with a culture built on grit, ownership, and mission.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to shape the technological foundation of our rapidly growing small business lending platform. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to design and implement cutting-edge financial technology solutions while working with a dynamic team focused on revolutionizing business financing. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in mobile application development and financial services technology to help us build scalable, secure, and innovative lending solutions.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Strategy

  • Design and evolve the comprehensive technical architecture for our lending platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Define and maintain architectural standards, patterns, and best practices across all technology initiatives
  • Lead technology selection and evaluation processes for new tools, frameworks, and platforms
  • Create technical roadmaps aligned with business objectives and product strategy
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development teams

Mobile Application Architecture

  • Architect and oversee the development of native mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms
  • Design mobile solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences for loan applications and account management
  • Ensure seamless integration between mobile applications and backend services
  • Optimize mobile application performance and offline capabilities


Platform Development

  • Collaborate with SaaS vendors to ensure platform configurations align with architectural standards
  • Design and implement API strategies for internal and external integrations
  • Architect microservices and serverless solutions using cloud services
  • Develop architecture strategies for analytics, reporting, and machine learning
  • Implement AI and automation solutions to streamline lending processes


Security & Compliance

  • Define security architecture and implement defense-in-depth strategies

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to shape the technological foundation of our rapidly growing small business lending platform. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to design and implement cutting-edge financial technology solutions while working with a dynamic team focused on revolutionizing business financing. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in mobile application development and financial services technology to help us build scalable, secure, and innovative lending solutions.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Strategy

  • Design and evolve the comprehensive technical architecture for our lending platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Define and maintain architectural standards, patterns, and best practices across all technology initiatives

  • Design mobile solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences for loan applications and account management

  • Design and implement API strategies for internal and external integrations
  • Architect microservices and serverless solutions using cloud services
  • Develop architecture strategies for analytics, reporting, and machine learning
  • Implement AI and automation solutions to streamline lending processes


Security & Compliance

  • Ensure architectural compliance with financial industry regulations and standards
  • Design secure data handling and encryption strategies for sensitive financial information
  • Lead security reviews and threat modeling exercises
  • Implement monitoring and incident response architectures

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Business Introduction

JD Industrials, a subsidiary of JD Group, focuses on industrial supply chain technologies and services, with a market capitalization of approximately $5 billion.

Our business is to support the development of enterprises from the industrial manufacturing industry through the integrated model of "supply chain + technology + service", and create a B to B procurement platform for industrial products. We provide industrial procurement solutions to more than 7,000 large customers and more than 8 million small and medium-sized business customers. We work with more than 30,000 suppliers of industrial goods, and our platform has more than 40 million SKUs .

Now JD Industrials focuses on developing overseas business, providing one-stop industrial product procurement solutions for enterprises from different countries. Our business has spread to Southeast Asia, Europe, the Middle East and South America .

Role Overview

We are looking for a key account manager with experience in to B sales.

Location: R. do Paraíso, 595 - 11o Andar - Paraíso, São Paulo - SP,

Job Description

  • Develop and cultivate customer relationships by identifying customer needs and conducting demand exploration.
  • Identify customer requirements and pain points, determine corresponding service strategies, coordinate company resources, and provide solutions to customers.
  • Collaborate closely with business, product, and operations teams to coordinate online purchasing, payment collection, and after-sales services for customers, aiming to enhance customer satisfaction.

Qualifications

  • Fluent in English and Chinese. Proficient in value-based sales.
  • Experience in successful development of new B2B customers and leading major projects.
  • Skilled in expanding business and mobilizing internal and external resources to solve business issues.
  • Strong sense of responsibility and teamwork. Excellent project management and resource integration skills.
  • Identification with JD culture and the online e-commerce industry.

title: Senior Software Architect
description:
About Specialty Capital

Specialty Capital was founded just four years ago with a bold idea - to give “debanked” small businesses access to capital that’s Simple, Smart, and Reliable. Today, the company is among the top revenue-based finance companies in the U.S., serving thousands of merchants through a combination of speed, technology, and a deeply human approach. We’re now entering our next chapter and scaling into new financial verticals (credit cards, payments, and neo-bank integrations) and expanding internationally, starting with Canada. The company is profitable, founder-led, and growing rapidly with a culture built on grit, ownership, and mission.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to shape the technological foundation of our rapidly growing small business lending platform. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to design and implement cutting-edge financial technology solutions while working with a dynamic team focused on revolutionizing business financing. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in mobile application development and financial services technology to help us build scalable, secure, and innovative lending solutions.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Strategy

  • Design and evolve the comprehensive technical architecture for our lending platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Define and maintain architectural standards, patterns, and best practices across all technology initiatives
  • Lead technology selection and evaluation processes for new tools, frameworks, and platforms
  • Create technical roadmaps aligned with business objectives and product strategy
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development teams

Mobile Application Architecture

  • Architect and oversee the development of native mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms
  • Design mobile solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences for loan applications and account management
  • Ensure seamless integration between mobile applications and backend services
  • Optimize mobile application performance and offline capabilities


Platform Development

  • Collaborate with SaaS vendors to ensure platform configurations align with architectural standards
  • Design and implement API strategies for internal and external integrations
  • Architect microservices and serverless solutions using cloud services
  • Develop architecture strategies for analytics, reporting, and machine learning
  • Implement AI and automation solutions to streamline lending processes


Security & Compliance

  • Define security architecture and implement defense-in-depth strategies
  • Ensure architectural compliance with financial industry regulations and standards
  • Design secure data handling and encryption strategies for sensitive financial information
  • Lead security reviews and threat modeling exercises
  • Implement monitoring and incident response architectures


Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical expertise in node.js, React, Swift, Java/Kotlin development
  • Review code, architectures, and technical designs to ensure quality and standards
  • Facilitate technical discussions and decision-making across teams
  • Establish development standards, coding practices, and documentation requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and technical practices

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; Master's degree preferred
  • 10-15 years of progressive experience in software architecture and development
  • Required: Extensive experience in mobile application development for iOS and Android platforms
  • Strong expertise in Swift for iOS and Java/Kotlin for Android development
  • Proven experience with financial technology platforms and payment systems
  • Deep knowledge of cloud architecture
  • Experience with node.js, React, mySQL, and modern web technologies
  • Strong background in API design, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, and reporting solutions
  • Understanding of cybersecurity best practices and financial services regulations
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in small business lending or commercial finance
  • Experience with Large Language Models / ML implementations in financial services
  • Knowledge of loan origination systems and credit decisioning platforms
  • Experience with React Native or cross-platform mobile development frameworks

What We Offer

  • Fully remote position with flexible working arrangements
  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Opportunity to shape the technical direction of a growing fintech company
  • Professional development opportunities and conference attendance
  • Collaborative environment with a focus on innovation and impact

Join Specialty Capital and play a pivotal role in revolutionizing small business lending through innovative technology solutions. As our Technical Architect, you'll have the opportunity to design systems that directly impact thousands of businesses across the country, helping them access the capital they need to grow and thrive.

Specialty Capital is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

We are…

A digital sports media group with an innovative approach and fan-first mentality, we're redefining how sports content is consumed and shared.

Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. Whether you are a sports fan or just curious, EMP is the place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.

You Are...

An experienced and driven graphic design professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

﻿

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Graphic Designer. The Graphic Designer will be responsible for creating visual content including graphics, logos, branding materials, and typography designs. You will collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement creative concepts and ensure brand consistency across all platforms. Daily tasks will include brainstorming ideas, executing design projects, and refining designs based on feedback.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Graphic Design and Graphics
  • Experience in Logo Design and Branding
  • Skills in Typography
  • Strong attention to detail and creativity
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Proficiency with design software such as Adobe Creative Suite
  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related field
  • Experience in digital media or marketing is a plus
  • Proficiency in English, spoken and written.

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Senior Software Architect
description:
About Specialty Capital

Specialty Capital was founded just four years ago with a bold idea - to give “debanked” small businesses access to capital that’s Simple, Smart, and Reliable. Today, the company is among the top revenue-based finance companies in the U.S., serving thousands of merchants through a combination of speed, technology, and a deeply human approach. We’re now entering our next chapter and scaling into new financial verticals (credit cards, payments, and neo-bank integrations) and expanding internationally, starting with Canada. The company is profitable, founder-led, and growing rapidly with a culture built on grit, ownership, and mission.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to shape the technological foundation of our rapidly growing small business lending platform. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to design and implement cutting-edge financial technology solutions while working with a dynamic team focused on revolutionizing business financing. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in mobile application development and financial services technology to help us build scalable, secure, and innovative lending solutions.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Strategy

  • Design and evolve the comprehensive technical architecture for our lending platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Define and maintain architectural standards, patterns, and best practices across all technology initiatives
  • Lead technology selection and evaluation processes for new tools, frameworks, and platforms
  • Create technical roadmaps aligned with business objectives and product strategy
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development teams

Mobile Application Architecture

  • Architect and oversee the development of native mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms
  • Design mobile solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences for loan applications and account management
  • Ensure seamless integration between mobile applications and backend services
  • Optimize mobile application performance and offline capabilities


Platform Development

  • Collaborate with SaaS vendors to ensure platform configurations align with architectural standards
  • Design and implement API strategies for internal and external integrations
  • Architect microservices and serverless solutions using cloud services
  • Develop architecture strategies for analytics, reporting, and machine learning
  • Implement AI and automation solutions to streamline lending processes


Security & Compliance

  • Define security architecture and implement defense-in-depth strategies
  • Ensure architectural compliance with financial industry regulations and standards
  • Design secure data handling and encryption strategies for sensitive financial information
  • Lead security reviews and threat modeling exercises
  • Implement monitoring and incident response architectures


Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical expertise in node.js, React, Swift, Java/Kotlin development
  • Review code, architectures, and technical designs to ensure quality and standards
  • Facilitate technical discussions and decision-making across teams
  • Establish development standards, coding practices, and documentation requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and technical practices

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; Master's degree preferred
  • 10-15 years of progressive experience in software architecture and development
  • Required: Extensive experience in mobile application development for iOS and Android platforms
  • Strong expertise in Swift for iOS and Java/Kotlin for Android development
  • Proven experience with financial technology platforms and payment systems
  • Deep knowledge of cloud architecture
  • Experience with node.js, React, mySQL, and modern web technologies
  • Strong background in API design, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, and reporting solutions
  • Understanding of cybersecurity best practices and financial services regulations
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in small business lending or commercial finance
  • Experience with Large Language Models / ML implementations in financial services
  • Knowledge of loan origination systems and credit decisioning platforms
  • Experience with React Native or cross-platform mobile development frameworks

What We Offer

  • Fully remote position with flexible working arrangements
  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Opportunity to shape the technical direction of a growing fintech company
  • Professional development opportunities and conference attendance
  • Collaborative environment with a focus on innovation and impact

Join Specialty Capital and play a pivotal role in revolutionizing small business lending through innovative technology solutions. As our Technical Architect, you'll have the opportunity to design systems that directly impact thousands of businesses across the country, helping them access the capital they need to grow and thrive.

Specialty Capital is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional Desenvolvedor Front end venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento front-end com ReactJS.
  • Conhecimento em HTML, CSS e JavaScript.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código, como Git.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Habilidades de resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Habilidade em trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação.
  • Proatividade para expor ideias e trazer melhorias.



Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter interfaces de usuário eficientes e responsivas utilizando React.
  • Contribuir para o Design System, ajudando a criar uma base sólida para nossos projetos.
  • Colaborar com designers, desenvolvedores back-end e outros membros da equipe para criar uma experiência de usuário de alta qualidade.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com desenvolvedores back-end para integração de APIs.
  • Implementar melhores práticas de desenvolvimento de software, incluindo testes automatizados e revisão de código.
  • Participar de reuniões de planejamento e contribuir com ideias para aprimorar o produto.
  • Garantir a compatibilidade entre diferentes navegadores e dispositivos.
  • Manter a performance, qualidade e responsividade das aplicações.
  • Adotar boas práticas de desenvolvimento, como a utilização de componentes reutilizáveis, padrões de nomenclatura consistentes e organização estruturada do código.
  • Manter a segurança em mente, implementando práticas de segurança recomendadas.





Modelo 100% home office

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Mid/Senior Vue.js Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re seeking a Frontend Engineer to help us build intuitive, performant, and modern user experiences with Vue.js and TypeScript . You’ll have the opportunity to work closely with talented engineers and designers, turning ideas into high-quality digital products that impact thousands of users.


What you will do :

  • Develop responsive and elegant web applications using Vue.js and TypeScript.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and improve data flow.
  • Translate design mockups into reusable and scalable components.
  • Continuously optimize applications for performance and accessibility.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and a great user experience on all devices.
  • Participate in code reviews and actively contribute to the team’s technical growth.


What we expect from you :

Mid-level:

  • Strong experience with Vue.js and its ecosystem (Vuex, Vue Router, etc.).
  • Solid knowledge of TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and working with version control (Git).
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks (Playwright).
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Senior-level:

  • Proven expertise in Vue.js and TypeScript, delivering complex and scalable frontends.
  • Ability to make architectural decisions and lead UI performance improvements.
  • Strong UX awareness and experience collaborating with design teams.
  • Experience mentoring and supporting junior engineers.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Additional Information:

  • CLT employment type;
  • Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Pessoa Compradora Sênior de TI
description:
MAIS QUE MERCADO

Somos parte de um dos maiores grupos varejistas do mundo, sendo o maior varejista do Brasil e um dos maiores empregadores privado do país, com mais de 130 mil pessoas colaboradoras, unidos no propósito de contribuir para uma alimentação mais acessível e de qualidade aos brasileiros e brasileiras.


Manifesto

No Grupo Carrefour Brasil, acreditamos que a verdadeira inclusão começa com a valorização das diferenças e a criação de um ambiente onde cada pessoa pode ser autêntica e alcançar seu pleno

potencial. Aqui, cada colaborador é respeitado e incentivado a trazer sua individualidade para o trabalho.

Nossa diversidade é a força que impulsiona nosso crescimento coletivo, criando um espaço de colaboração onde todos têm a oportunidade de prosperar.


O desenvolvimento profissional é parte essencial do que oferecemos. Acreditamos que o crescimento é uma jornada contínua, e por isso fornecemos as ferramentas e oportunidades necessárias para que cada colaborador possa expandir suas habilidades e evoluir dentro da empresa. Seja por meio da escola de líderes, programas afirmativos ou vagas internas, garantimos que todos possam avançar em seu próprio ritmo, construindo uma trajetória de sucesso dentro do Grupo.


A ascensão social faz parte do nosso compromisso em transformar vidas. Valorizamos o esforço e a dedicação, oferecendo caminhos claros para o crescimento. Muitos de nossos colaboradores que iniciaram suas carreiras em posições operacionais, como estoquistas ou operadores de caixa, têm a oportunidade de, por meio de nosso apoio e desenvolvimento contínuo, alcançar cargos de supervisão, gerência e até CEO.


No Grupo Carrefour Brasil, acreditamos que o sucesso não tem limites e todos podem crescer com

dedicação e apoio. Inclusão, desenvolvimento e ascensão social caminham JUNTOS.

Aqui, você pode ser você mesmo, evoluir como profissional e transformar a sua vida e a de sua família.


Venha fazer parte dessa história!



Sobre a área:

DCI: Departamento de Compras de Indiretos, responsável pelas negociações para contratação de prestadores de serviços, compra de produtos, materiais, equipamentos e ativos em geral, para utilização pelo Carrefour e empresas do Grupo.

Desafios dessa posição:

A pessoa compradora Sênior de TI será responsável pela negociação de indiretos de TI, incluindo contratos de serviços de tecnologia, softwares e hardwares. Entre suas principais atividades estão:

  • Negociação de novos contratos de TI;
  • Renegociação e gestão de renovações de contratos existentes;
  • Gestão da categoria de TI, garantindo alinhamento com as necessidades de todas as unidades de negócio (BUs) do grupo.

O objetivo dessas atividades é conduzir negociações estratégicas que resultem em redução de custos e economia para a empresa, contribuindo para a eficiência das operações de tecnologia e o sucesso do negócio.


Você precisa ter:

Ensino Superior;

Experiência na área de compras de indiretos em TI;

Conhecimento em Strategic Sourcing, TCO, Cost breakdown;

Inglês avançado e/ou Fluente;

Domínio do Pacote Office.

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.

  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.

  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:

  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Marketing Cloud Consultant
description:

  • Perform troubleshooting and implement best practices for deliverability and governance.
  • Suggest technical improvements for projects.
  • Execute SFMC best practices.
  • Monitor CRM KPIs.
  • Communicate with clients and provide technical support.

  • Provide technical detailing for journey construction.

  • Proven experience in SFMC.
  • Knowledge of SQL, Data Views, and integrations.
  • Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and Ampscript.
  • Experience with projects involving Data Cloud/CDP, particularly in segmentation.
  • Experience in creating and customizing campaign templates.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team with a strong results-oriented mindset.

Skill Set:

  • Strong technical skills in Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Effective communication skills for client interaction and support.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in a CRM journey project focused on banking products.
  • Familiarity with working in a multidisciplinary squad, including roles such as PO, CRM strategy professionals, SFMC and SFDC experts, and creative/design teams.

title: Mid/Senior Vue.js Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re seeking a Frontend Engineer to help us build intuitive, performant, and modern user experiences with Vue.js and TypeScript . You’ll have the opportunity to work closely with talented engineers and designers, turning ideas into high-quality digital products that impact thousands of users.


What you will do :

  • Develop responsive and elegant web applications using Vue.js and TypeScript.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and improve data flow.
  • Translate design mockups into reusable and scalable components.
  • Continuously optimize applications for performance and accessibility.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and a great user experience on all devices.
  • Participate in code reviews and actively contribute to the team’s technical growth.


What we expect from you :

Mid-level:

  • Strong experience with Vue.js and its ecosystem (Vuex, Vue Router, etc.).
  • Solid knowledge of TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and working with version control (Git).
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks (Playwright).
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Senior-level:

  • Proven expertise in Vue.js and TypeScript, delivering complex and scalable frontends.
  • Ability to make architectural decisions and lead UI performance improvements.
  • Strong UX awareness and experience collaborating with design teams.
  • Experience mentoring and supporting junior engineers.
  • Good English communication skills (written and spoken).


Additional Information:

  • CLT employment type;
  • Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Business/Function Analysts
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Business/Function Analysts , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.


In this role you will:

The IT Business/Functional Analyst plays a critical role in bridging business needs with technological solutions. The primary function is to analyze and interpret business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and collaborate with stakeholders to ensure that technology solutions are aligned with the company's objectives. This role requires working closely with business users, developers, and project managers to deliver effective technology solutions that enhance business processes and improve efficiency.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Requirements Analysis and Specification: Conduct in-depth analysis of business requirements, translating them into detailed functional specifications for the development team. Create wireframes and mockups to visualize the proposed solutions.
  • Solution Design and Testing: Collaborating with developers and system architects to design solutions that meet business needs. Develop and execute test plans and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Stakeholder Management and Leadership: Building and maintaining effective relationships with key stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Lead and coordinate project activities, ensuring that tasks are completed on time.
  • Risk Management and Budgeting: Identify and mitigate risks in technology projects. Assist in managing project budgets and ensure the use of resources in a cost-effective manner.
  • Documentation and Support: Create comprehensive user documentation and training materials. Provide ongoing technical support for implemented solutions.
  • Continuous Improvement: Analyze and resolve system problems and incidents. Participate in change management to ensure smooth transitions and user adoption.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 to 7 years of experience as a business or functional analyst in an IT environment.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Languages: Advanced English and/or French.



Tools and Abilities:

  • Proficiency in business analytics tools such as Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, Signavio .
  • Experience with project management software such as Jira, Trello, Microsoft Project, and Asana .
  • Knowledge in SQL and experience with databases such as Oracle, SQL Server and MySQL.
  • Familiarity with SDLC methodologies , including Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall .
  • Experience with ERP systems such as SAP and CRM systems such as Salesforce .

Soft Skills:

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Problem Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Collaboration: Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and lead project activities.
  • Leadership: Proven experience in project and team management, with the ability to mentor junior team members.

Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Education: Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration or related field.
  • Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), PMP (Project Management Professional), or Certified ScrumMaster .
  • Knowledge: Experience in specific industries such as finance, healthcare, or manufacturing. Advanced programming skills in languages such as Python, Java or C# .

title: Senior Market Research Analyst
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights e consultoria, que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo? Então essa é a sua chance!


O que buscamos:

A Worldpanel está em busca de um(a) Analista de Pesquisa de Mercado Sênior com interesse genuíno em entender o comportamento do consumidor e transformar dados em insights que orientem decisões estratégicas. Se você tem espírito investigativo, atenção aos detalhes e gosta de trabalhar com dados e pessoas, essa vaga pode ser para você!


As responsabilidades incluem:

  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares, especialmente o time comercial;
  • Receber, analisar e criticar briefings, produzindo materiais alinhados às demandas;
  • Atuar em atividades de maior complexidade e interagir com stakeholders seniores;
  • Participar, quando possível, das apresentações para clientes;
  • Diagnosticar oportunidades de negócio nos clientes para abordagem comercial;
  • Produzir insights adicionais que possam gerar novas oportunidades;
  • Participar de reuniões de briefing com clientes, se necessário;
  • Sintetizar informações, construir storytelling com dados e comunicar-se bem com diferentes públicos;
  • Cumprir os prazos estabelecidos no cronograma de entregas (SLA e priorizações).


Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia em análise de mercado, comportamento do consumidor ou inteligência de mercado;
  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Comunicação, Estatística, Marketing ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pensamento analítico, visão estratégica, autonomia, organização e proatividade;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em pacote Office;
  • Atenção aos detalhes e habilidades para resolver problemas;
  • Inglês avançado (desejável espanhol intermediário);
  • Conhecimento na plataforma Jira será considerado diferencial.


O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

  • Horário Flexível;
  • Home-office;
  • Programa Qualidade de Vida: Totalpass, participação em corridas, vacinação contra gripe, palestras sobre temas relevantes e muito mais;
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna – a Worldpanel valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua.

title: Analista Desenvolvedor Cobol Pleno
description:
Key Responsibilities

• Realizar manutenções e desenvolvimento de aplicações Cobol para plataformas Mainframe Unisys;

• Definição de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais;

• Definir solução técnica, fazer estimativas de esforço e prazos, assegurando a entrega dentro do cronograma estabelecido.;

• Codificar e realizar testes unitários; Atuar em colaboração com o time diariamente para avaliar progresso das atividades e avaliar riscos de projeto, promovendo uma abordagem proativa na resolução de problemas.;

• Contribuir de forma multidisciplinar com objetivo de ajudar o time a atingir as metas, participando ativamente em discussões e oferecendo suporte sempre que necessário;

• Colaborar com outros membros da equipe para promover boas práticas de desenvolvimento e manutenção de software, incentivando a inovação e aprimoramento contínuo.


Key Qualifications

• Graduação completa na área de tecnologia: Sistemas da Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins;

• Inglês intermediário para compreensão e leitura

title: Gerente de vendas
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de Vendas com perfil estratégico, liderança inspiradora e forte atuação comercial para assumir a gestão dos canais Distribuidores nos Estados do Rio de Janeiro e Espírito Santo.


Local de atuação: Rio de Janeiro, será responsável pelas regiões do RJ e ES

Home office, modalidade de contratação PJ


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar e desenvolver o time de Executivos de Vendas
  • Gerenciar os canais Alimentar (direto e indireto), Cash & Carry e Contas Chave
  • Garantir excelência na execução comercial e visibilidade no PDV
  • Desenvolver planos de negócios e relacionamento estratégico com clientes
  • Avaliar desempenho de mercado via Market Share e ferramentas analíticas
  • Alinhar e executar estratégias de Trade Marketing
  • Gerenciar margens e assegurar cumprimento da política comercial


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida na indústria de bens de consumo
  • Atuação comprovada com Distribuidores, Cash & Carry, Atacadistas e Varejistas no RJ e ES
  • Vivência com Contas KA
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Nielsen, Scanntech, Sell-In/Sell-Out, Ruptura, Market Share
  • Forte conhecimento em execução no PDV e Trade Marketing
  • Formação superior em Administração, Marketing, Publicidade ou áreas correlatas (Pós/MBA desejável)
  • Pacote Office avançado
  • Perfil estratégico, comunicativo, flexível e com excelente relacionamento interpessoal
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
For many of us, there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.


About the Engineering Team

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.


On your day to day

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Remote) who’s passionate about technology, performance, and crafting amazing user experiences. You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

If you love building seamless, high-performance web experiences - we’d love to meet you.


What Will Make You Stand Out?

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles
  • Good experience with Node.js, MongoDB, and RESTful APIs
  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

title: Analista Sênior De Projetos De Serviços
description:
Sobre a empresa

Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


Aqui temos um ambiente dinâmico, que celebra a diversidade, promove a inclusão e está sempre em busca dos melhores resultados! Acreditamos no poder transformador da tecnologia e na sua capacidade de contribuir para a construção de uma sociedade mais diversa e inclusiva. Por isso, temos compromisso com nossa política e programa de diversidade e inclusão para garantirmos um ecossistema cada vez mais representativo, respeitoso e acolhedor.


#ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVS


Descrição da vaga

Responsável pela condução de projetos de implantação/evolução junto ao cliente, visando assegurar a qualidade e o sucesso da implantação, reunindo os recursos necessários para cumprir os prazos e entregas junto ao cliente

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conduzir projetos de alta complexidade e alto volume de horas, com personalização e de clientes estratégicos;
  • Inovar e criar novos processos que aumentem a eficiência dos projetos;
  • Construir indicadores relevantes para a área, com objetivo de identificar oportunidades, gerar insights e auxiliar na tomada de decisão;
  • Mentorar TOTVERS com menos conhecimento sobre a aplicação de métodos e processos da área de projetos e ferramentas;
  • Ser ponto focal, para clientes e áreas internas repassando dados e informações por meio de e-mails, calls/reuniões e registros em sistema;
  • Identificar os riscos do projetos sob sua responsabilidade, registrando em sistema;
  • Garantir a assiduidade do apontamento das horas em projetos sob sua responsabilidade de todos os recursos alocados;
  • Planejar e alocar os recursos envolvidos no projeto;
  • Garantir o faturamento em tempo correto dos projetos de serviços, conforme contratação realizada pelo cliente junto à proposta comercial;
  • Garantir a rentabilidade financeira dos projetos de serviços sob sua responsabilidade.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação: Graduação completa em Administração, estatística, Tecnologia da Informação, engenharias, economia, Marketing ou áreas afins. Pós graduação em Gestão de Projetos, Gestão comercial ou gestão empresarial.
  • Conhecimentos específicos: Pacote Office - Excel, Conhecimento teórico das ferramentas e filosofias de projeto.
  • Experiência: Desejável vivência profissional em condução de projetos ou especialização em gestão de projetos

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Organização e gestão de prioridades
  • Comunicação eficaz (oral e escrita)
  • Visão sistêmica e foco em processos
  • Proatividade e atitude de dono
  • Relacionamento interpessoal e empatia
  • Resiliência e estabilidade emocional
  • Senso de urgência e comprometimento com entregas
  • Escuta ativa e entendimento de contexto


CLT

Benefícios

  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada pessoa colaboradora;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para nossas pessoas colaboradoras;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para pessoas colaboradoras e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Bicicletário;
  • Vestiário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;
  • Gympass.

title: Consultor(a) Funcional SAP PP/QM
description:
Consultor(a) SAP PP/QM Senior

Brasil - Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Sobre a Motivus

Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Estamos em busca de um consultor funcional altamente qualificado e experiente, especializado em SAP PP-PI (Planejamento da Produção para Indústrias de Processos) , REM (Manufatura Repetitiva) , MRP (Planejamento das Necessidades de Materiais) , Gestão da Qualidade (QM) e Arquivamento . O consultor será responsável pela documentação, gestão de cronogramas, implantação e suporte pós-implantação (hypercare) das funcionalidades liberadas, seguindo as metodologias e práticas de governança da PepsiCo. É essencial ter habilidade de comunicação eficaz em inglês, tanto falado quanto escrito. O profissional poderá estar localizado em qualquer país da região da América Latina (LATAM).


Responsabilidades:

  • Analisar e compreender os requisitos de negócio para projetar e implementar soluções SAP PP/QM que atendam às necessidades do cliente.
  • Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos para usuários finais, garantindo a adoção bem-sucedida das soluções SAP PP/QM.
  • Realizar análise de processos de negócios e propor recomendações para melhorias.
  • Colaborar com os clientes para identificar e priorizar melhorias nos processos de planejamento da produção.
  • Desenvolver e manter a documentação das configurações, processos e procedimentos do SAP PP/QM.
  • Oferecer suporte contínuo e manutenção dos sistemas SAP PP/QM.
  • Executar testes, configurações, implementações e suporte pós-implantação (hypercare) das soluções.
  • Analisar e preparar objetos para arquivamento.


Habilidades e Qualificações:

  • Experiência comprovada em implementação, configuração e otimização de SAP PP/QM.
  • Sólido conhecimento em princípios e práticas de planejamento da produção.
  • Excelentes habilidades analíticas, de resolução de problemas e de comunicação.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma eficaz em equipes multifuncionais e de construir relacionamentos sólidos com colegas e usuários.
  • Certificações SAP PP/QM ou experiência equivalente (experiência prática em negócios é muito importante).
  • Forte compreensão do SAP ERP e integração com outros módulos (MM, WM, FICO).
  • Inglês técnico (falado e escrito).
  • Capacidade de atuar em múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.
  • Conhecimento sobre produção de bens de consumo.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em qualquer fuso horário da América Latina (México ou Brasil).
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA (desejável).
  • Ingles: avançado
  • Espanhol: intermediário/avançado


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira : Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes : Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo : Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente : Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores

  • Cultura de Inovação : Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade : Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.

Sobre a Motivus

Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. O consultor será responsável pela documentação, gestão de cronogramas, implantação e suporte pós-implantação (hypercare) das funcionalidades liberadas, seguindo as metodologias e práticas de governança da PepsiCo.
